methodological_rigor.justification: Bioinformatics-driven discovery with in vitro functional validation in single cell line (SACC-83). GEO dataset analysis (GSE88804, GSE153002 merged; n=54 ACC, 17 normal; GSE36820 n=11 ACC, 3 normal) identifies NUF2 via hub gene analysis (STRING + Cytoscape). Clinical validation minimal: only N=2 ACC samples for IHC/Western (line 23: 'only 2 patients met inclusion criteria'). NUF2 knockdown tested in one cell line with CCK-8 and wound healing; no dose-response, no mechanism investigation. Immune analysis via in silico ssGSEA without experimental validation. Statistical tests appropriate (ANOVA, Wilcoxon) but severely underpowered due to sample size.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Preclinical bioinformatics + single cell line functional work mapping to LoE 5 (mechanistic, no clinical data). NUF2 upregulation documented in various cancers but specificity to ACC unproven functionally. Minimal clinical data (N=2 tissue samples). Proposed association with immune infiltration is purely computational (ssGSEA, TIMER correlation); no immunophenotyping, no patient outcome correlation, no translational pathway established. Authors acknowledge: 'Fundamental research and clinical trials are needed to further validate NUF2 as a therapeutic target in ACC.'

reporting_quality.justification: Bioinformatics methods detailed; GEO dataset accession numbers provided but multiple database URLs redacted ('PubMed [REDACTED]', 'TIMER database [REDACTED]'). IHC and Western blotting protocols described but applied to only N=2 and N=2 ACC tissues respectively. Cell line experiments in triplicate but single cell line used. ARRIVE-adjacent for cell-based work but severely underpowered clinical validation. No data availability statement for code or processed datasets. Authors note limited sample availability as key limitation.

novelty_literature.justification: NUF2 established as oncogene in multiple cancers (hepatocellular, renal, gastric, breast); present study is first to characterize NUF2 in ACC specifically. Modest novelty: applies known kinetochore component to new cancer type. Immune infiltration analysis is exploratory but speculative without experimental validation. GO enrichment shows NUF2-related genes in 'ameboidal migration,' 'chromosome segregation'—mechanisms consistent with kinetochore function.

writing_presentation.justification: Logically organized: screening → hub gene identification → functional validation. Figures effectively present hub gene overlap (Fig. 2D), expression validation (Fig. 3), GO enrichment (Fig. 4), immune correlation (Fig. 5), functional data (Fig. 6). However, extensive redaction of database URLs impedes verification and transparency. Discussion appropriately contextualizes NUF2 in TME; authors acknowledge limitations (HNSC vs. ACC extrapolation, ssGSEA limitations, small sample size).

key_strengths: First characterization of NUF2 in ACC context; systematic bioinformatics discovery identifies NUF2 among 7 hub genes via degree/MCC/MNC consensus
Multi-platform validation: GEO datasets + TIMER + IHC + Western blotting demonstrates NUF2 upregulation trend
Functional validation: NUF2 knockdown reduces ACC cell proliferation (CCK-8, P<0.0001) and migration (wound healing, P=0.0004) in SACC-83 cells
Exploratory immune analysis: ssGSEA identifies NUF2 correlation with activated CD4+ T cells, memory B cells, providing TME context
key_concerns: Severe underpowering of clinical validation: only N=2 ACC patients for IHC/Western (line 23 explicitly states 'only 2 patients met inclusion criteria'); IHC scores 6/6 vs. 3/4 (paired) insufficient for robust assertion
Single cell line functional studies (SACC-83 only); no comparison across multiple ACC cell lines; no dose-response curve; no mechanistic pathway exploration

Immune infiltration analysis purely in silico: TIMER correlation analysis uses HNSC cohort (not ACC); ssGSEA is bulk RNA-seq prediction without flow cytometry or multiplex IHC validation; authors acknowledge 'correlation derived from bulk RNA-seq data can be susceptible to confounding'
Extensive database URL redaction prevents verification and reproducibility assessment
No data availability statement; processed datasets and code not accessible
Novelty modest: NUF2 is established oncogene; application to ACC is incremental without mechanistic discovery
chief_reviewer.rationale: Competent exploratory bioinformatics study identifying NUF2 as potential ACC biomarker but critically limited by N=2 clinical samples, single cell line, and in silico immune analysis. Requires major revisions: expanded patient cohorts, multi-cell line validation, functional mechanistic studies, and experimental immune profiling for higher-tier consideration.
